implementationDecisions: Current official client QuJia 3778 is the limited once-per-game version, while JiaWei1 3799 remains the current active skill. The unavailable hero/API and the superseded guide do not override those current rows.

Jiawei selects any living role, including self and an empty role when no payment is possible. This follows 一名角色 plus the explicit first-turn X=0 and insufficient-card guide details; no artificial other-target or minimum-card restriction is added.

X is frozen before selection as min(number of genuine completed own TurnEnded receipts, current maximum HP). Extra turns and the engine actual face-up skipped turn count because they produce genuine own start/end receipts. The current uncompleted turn does not count.

The available HEJ discard set and exact required count are frozen. Foreign hand choices use opaque zone/slot choices. All choices finish before one native primary discard batch, preserving GeneralWeapon OutsideGame normalization and real Silver Lion/Wooden Ox children.

Jiawei reveals actual X+1 top entities through the existing native public reveal operation, including native exhaustion and reshuffle. No missing entity is manufactured. Damage-card classification includes actual Slash-family, Duel, Fire Attack, both AOEs, Lightning and the existing Unexpected Assault card; optional view-as abilities do not change a revealed deck entity.

Each revealed entity has a frozen original Processing residency and partition. It can only be claimed from that original residency; children that move an entity away do not allow its replacement or a later reacquisition. Original damage entities go to Yang Feng, other entities go to the frozen target. A dead recipient gains nothing, and remaining original entities settle to discard.

Native gained/lost-card, recovery/replacement, HP, skill-change and dying children resume their exact owning ProgramSkillFrame without repaying completed discard/reveal/gain stages. Paid skill loss retains the issued resolution.

The distance grant uses the existing actual-turn CardUseDistanceLimit unlimited modifier after Jiawei settles, applying to all distance-restricted card uses. It grants no Slash quota, no arbitrary target permission and no physical-distance change.

Qujia uses the actual AfterTurnEnded parent, an optional game-limited activation, a frozen no-kill fact and the existing typed PendingBeneficiarySeat extra-turn progression. A real owner-attributed PlayerDied killer record anywhere in that actual turn blocks the offer.

The once-per-game Qujia consumption is additionally event-derived by actual owner and skill identity, so a new runtime skill instance cannot refresh it after genuine loss/regrant. The permanent Slash quota is a separately issued, proven scalar event and survives source loss.

The obtain branch selects one actual Slash-family card from the real draw pile, using the native empty-pile reshuffle contract. If no Slash exists, it gains no card while retaining its selected permanent +1 Slash quota. This exact name search and the enduring grant after loss are stated-text/native-contract inferences; no current product FAQ specifies a different fallback.

validation.scope: Real public and private commands, native actual turns and card movements, paid recovery/grain/dying children, source loss and genuine new-instance regrant, cold checkpoint/replay and atomic invalid-command rejection. No duplicate character definition snapshot.
validation.result: Focused native behavior, relevant shared regressions, real WPF gallery and measured routine verification passed.
